name: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
why: Striped red, yellow and green slopes at 5,000 m, with the Ausangate glacier behind: short, but at an altitude that hurts.
book: Tours leave Cusco at 04:00; a community fee at the trailhead (cash, soles). Horses can carry you most of the way up.
water: Bring 1.5 litres; the women at the trailhead sell coca tea.
dangers: You walk between 4,600 and 5,036 m: never on your first days in Cusco.
Snow and hail possible any afternoon; the colours fade under cloud.
turnaround: Any headache, dizziness or breathlessness at rest: go down at once.

points.name: Vinicunca trailhead with alpacas
points.note: The Quesiuno car park at about 4,600 m: horses and alpacas wait here.

points.name: Vinicunca valley with Ausangate
points.note: The gentle valley; the Ausangate glacier appears to the east.

points.name: Vinicunca
points.note: 5,036 m: the striped mountain from the top of the last zigzags.

points.note: 10 minutes past the top: a whole valley of red earth, often empty.
